scripts.prepare-assets: mkdir -p public/assets public/css && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && cp css/site-nav.css public/css/
scripts.prepare-assets:clean: rm -rf public/assets public/assets-manifest.json && FORCE_OPTIMIZE=1 npm run prepare-assets
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fireflyofsoulstudio --branch=production --commit-dirty=true
